# Kitchen Sink Leak Maintenance Request

A clear, tenant-friendly message you can send by email, plus a short follow-up and a simple documentation checklist.

## Email Request to Landlord

**Subject:** Maintenance Request: Leaking Kitchen Sink in 2-Bedroom Apartment

Hello [Landlord/Property Manager Name],

I’m writing to report a maintenance issue in my 2-bedroom apartment in Chicago, Illinois. The kitchen sink has been leaking continuously since **2026-03-02**. Water is dripping at a steady rate, and I’ve noticed a small stain beginning to form in the cabinet below the sink. I do not see any mold at this time.

Please arrange for the sink to be repaired within **7 days** of this message, if possible. Since the leak is ongoing, I’d appreciate a prompt response and a repair appointment as soon as available.

Thank you for your attention to this matter. Please confirm receipt of this email and let me know the next steps.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
[Apartment Number]
[Phone Number]
[Email Address]

## Short Follow-Up Message

Hello [Landlord/Property Manager Name],

I’m following up on my email about the leaking kitchen sink in my apartment. The leak is still ongoing, and I’d appreciate an update on when repair service can be scheduled. Please confirm receipt when you can.

Thank you,
[Your Name]

## Photo and Note Checklist

- Take a clear photo of the sink with the leak visible.
- Take a video showing the water dripping continuously.
- Photograph the cabinet stain under the sink.
- Take a wider photo of the kitchen area for context.
- Note the date and time you first noticed the leak.
- Record how often the dripping happens and whether it changes.
- Save copies of all emails and any replies.
- Write down any damage changes, including new stains, odors, or moisture.
- If safe, note whether the water supply shutoff valve is accessible and working.
- Keep a simple log of each communication attempt and response.

## Quick Actions
